sources.title: Green AI: Exploring Carbon Footprints, Mitigation Strategies, and Trade ...
sources.snippet: Currently, investigations into the CO2 emissions of AI models remain an emerging area of research, and as such, in this paper, we evaluate the CO2 emissions of well-known large language models, which have an especially high carbon footprint due to their significant amount of model parameters.
